purpose: Post-hoc start-frequency sensitivity diagnostic for the q≈5 aligned-spin SXS:BBH:2508 case, selected because its earlier five-case optimized native/NR overlap was the lowest. This is not an independent holdout or a release gate.
start_frequency_convention: Dimensionless orbital M Omega; below the catalog reference orbital frequency 0.02307715769169308 for this simulation.
comparison: Same fine RKF45 numerical settings and NR mode as the frozen five-case evidence; report fixed-crossing and post-hoc unweighted time/phase optimized metrics. No parameter or amplitude optimization.
